prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art directional sprite atlas for SCP Survivor.
Create NEW sprites for THREE EXISTING game weapons, NOT new gameplay models. The attached approval sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: muted tactical olive, charcoal, light steel, clear tiny silhouettes. Do not copy the sheet layout, text, background or any reference weapon identity.
STRICT OUTPUT LAYOUT: exactly SIX evenly spaced ROWS and EIGHT evenly spaced COLUMNS, 48 isolated sprites total. Columns in order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE in screen coordinates. E points right, S down, W left, N up. Fixed steep overhead game camera, actual weapon turns in the ground plane; muzzle/end points along each specified angle. North views must show top/back surfaces, no down-facing muzzle on N. Each weapon and all parts must fit comfortably in its cell, no neighboring overlap, generous empty alpha padding.
PAIRED DESIGNS: odd rows are coarse genuinely 16x16 logical pixel studies, even rows are their independently refined 32x32 studies. Same apparent physical length within each pair; odd rows have clearly larger square pixel blocks, even rows finer pixels. Crisp nearest-neighbor hard edges, no antialiasing, gradients, painted texture, bloom or soft shadows. Approximately 10-12 colors in coarse and 16-20 in fine.
Rows1/2: SUBFUSIL, runtime smg. Compact practical submachine gun with short steel receiver, tiny dark muzzle, short olive folding stock, dark pistol grip and straight small magazine. Clear submachine gun silhouette, shorter and thicker than the shotgun. No scope, no suppressor, no giant assault rifle, no sci-fi details, no beams. Keep same weapon details across8facings.
Rows3/4: ESCOPETA, runtime shotgun. Practical pump shotgun with straight long steel barrel, warm brown wooden stock and ribbed pump fore-end, simple pistol grip beneath receiver. Distinct long straight gun; no scope, no drum magazine or grenades. Eight consistent facings.
Rows5/6: PORRA, runtime baton. Plain straight security baton with dark graphite cylindrical striking shaft, short olive wrapped grip, thin muted steel collar and rounded blunt end. It is a slender stick, NOT hammer, mace, axe, sword or electric weapon. Handle end opposite blunt tip in all8directions; slightly foreshortened N/S. No energy trail on body.
Bodies only: NO people, hands, body parts, bullets, attack effects, floor, grid, labels, arrows, text, checkerboard or decorative frame. Actual transparent alpha surrounding solid opaque sprites. Background fully transparent. Exactly48separate sprites. Horizontal aspect suitable for8columns and6rows.
referenceRole: Solo estilo: lámina aprobada ARM-VIS-001/R1; no se modifica ni se amplía su aprobación.
